noun_definition: mweb refers to the mobile version of the Expensify web application where users can manage workspace settings, including adding and saving tax rates.

Tax refers to a financial charge that users can define within the workspace settings of the application, which includes a name and value, and is subject to an error message when saved without modification.
Tax name refers to the label or identifier assigned to a specific tax rate that the user inputs when adding a new tax rate in the workspace settings.
Displays error message refers to the notification shown to the user indicating a problem when attempting to save a tax name without making any changes to it.
